stories.title: Sponsored: Sepsis—What you need to know
stories.summary: Usually, the human body is able to heal and recover from infection. But sometimes, infection can confuse our immune systems and lead to a response that can damage vital organs and, potentially, be fatal. This reaction is called sepsis.
